children.value: > Fact From Story: Rebel board members tried to force out Altman because, they believed, they could no longer trust him to build AI that would benefit humanity.
> > Fact From Story: Last month that infighting came to OpenAI’s boardroom.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A company's board of directors has the power to fire its CEO.
> Fact From Story: Last month that infighting came to OpenAI’s boardroom.

> > Fact From Story: Over five chaotic days, OpenAI looked as if it were going to fall apart, until the board – pressured by giant investors and employees who threatened to follow Altman out the door – backed down.
> > > Fact From Story: The drama inside OpenAI gave the world its first glimpse of the bitter feuds among those who will determine the future of AI.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Internal conflicts within a company can be disruptive and indicate underlying issues.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Investors and employees can exert pressure on a company's board of directors.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A company's board of directors has the power to fire its CEO.
